game.title: Sunloaf
game.tagline: Arrange the afternoon. Then take the nap.
game.controls: WASD move, mouse look, Shift sneak, Space jump, click pounce, E use, Esc pause

session.notes: Single session, no human help. Original courtyard game (Miso, six comforts, a saucer shop, an ivy climb, a nap). All models, textures, animation and sound are procedural in this run. three.js r187 is the vendored library only. Verified in headless Chromium with the repo shot script and npm run check; the test machine is software GL, so shadow quality was judged from the code path rather than a discrete GPU.

game.title: Gifts for the Tall One
game.tagline: You are a cat on a small island. The human in the cottage cannot hunt, so you bring it things: butterflies, a sock, its own goldfish.
game.controls: WASD move, mouse look, Space hop (hold to aim a pounce), C sneak, Shift run, E use, J journal, M meow

session.notes: Not a blind attempt: this model also designed the benchmark and wrote BRIEF.md in the same session, before building the game. One prompt, no human help. Tested only in headless Chromium on software GL; never played by a person or on a real GPU before submission.

game.title: Knock Theory
game.tagline: The Tall One has gone to work and gravity will not test itself: spend one sunlit day knocking the flat onto the floor, for science.
game.controls: WASD move, mouse look (drag if unlocked), Shift zoomies, Space jump (hold to pounce), click/F swat, Q meow, Esc pause

session.notes: Single session in Claude Code on a headless Linux box. No human help after the initial prompt. Everything (models, textures, animation, sound, music) is generated by code in runs/claude-opus-5-5/js; only three.js from vendor/ is used. Verified with headless Chromium (software GL) through scripted playtests via a ?debug&manual hook, plus npm run check. Real-time feel and audio were never experienced first-hand: the machine has no GPU and audio is muted, so tuning was by reasoning, traces and screenshots.

game.title: The Midnight Purrade
game.tagline: Be a cat. Gather a rooftop choir. Wake the moon.
game.controls: WASD / arrows move; Space pounce; E hold to invite / tap to meow; Shift scamper; drag to turn the camera; R reset camera; Esc pause; M sound. Touch stick and buttons also supported.

session.notes: Solo attempt in T3 Code using GPT-6.1 Sol at high reasoning effort. No subagents or external assets. Used the frontend-design skill for visual planning. All models, animation, UI, sound and music authored in this session. Pinned Playwright tooling installed inside this run to preserve the brief directory boundary. Only this run was inspected; the repository check regenerates the permitted manifest.

game.title: The Moonlight Supper
game.tagline: The market is closed. Your friends are hungry. You are a cat. Make arrangements.
game.controls: WASD / arrows move, Space jump, Shift run, F / click swat, E serve / hold to purr, Q meow, M sound, Escape pause; optional touch controls.

session.notes: Created independently in one session by GPT-6 Astra (high reasoning) in T3 Code through the Codex harness.
